STEP 2 - Vessel: A large rectangular/angular white dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm². The plate is partly cut off at the right, so I treat it as a ~26 cm dinner plate.

STEP 3 - Items: pizza slice with pepperoni; roasted meat slices; cauliflower florets; roasted potato wedges (yellow); crumbed/breaded piece; roasted dark vegetable piece; arugula.

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, sums to ~70%):

- Roasted meat: 10% = 53 cm² x 1.5 cm = 80 ml x 1.0 = 80 g; 200 kcal/100g → 160 kcal
- Cauliflower: 7% = 37 cm² x 2 cm = 74 ml x 0.6 = 44 g; 25 kcal/100g → 11 kcal
- Roasted potato wedges: 9% = 48 cm² x 2 cm = 96 ml x 0.6 = 58 g; 110 kcal/100g → 64 kcal
- Breaded piece: 12% = 64 cm² x 1.5 cm = 96 ml x 0.9 = 86 g; 230 kcal/100g → 198 kcal
- Roasted dark vegetable: 4% = 21 cm² x 1.5 cm = 32 ml x 0.6 = 19 g; 60 kcal/100g → 11 kcal
- Arugula: 4% = 21 cm² x 2 cm = 42 ml x 0.15 = 6 g; 25 kcal/100g → 2 kcal

STEP 5–6 - Totals: about 356 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: about 690 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A partly eaten plate with a few food items spread across roughly two-thirds of a dinner plate; ~350 g and ~700 kcal is plausible for this visible amount.
